founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Thomas is co-founder and CEO of Rewbi, which uses AI to optimize grid-connected battery storage. He previously founded inBalance, a YC W21 company, which was acquired by Stem (NYSE: STEM) in January of 2023. He led battery storage optimization and forecasting for Stem. He completed part of a Pure Mathematics PhD at University of Cambridge, which he left to build inBalance. He holds a Masters in Applied Mathematics and B.S.E. in Pure and Applied Mathematics from Johns Hopkins, graduating early.

launches.title: Rewbi - We build data centers 10x faster
launches.tagline: Rewbi deploys 1-10MW distributed data centers in existing industrial buildings with surplus power, which is 10+ times faster than standard data center deployment.
launches.body:
We deploy 1-10MW distributed data centers in existing industrial buildings with surplus power, which is 10+ times faster than standard data center deployment. We call our network of data centers the Rewbi Edge Inference Grid, which is designed for secure, reliable, and fast access to compute. Using our vertically integrated approach, our pilot B300 site was deployed in 39 days and is now live. 

I’ve spent the past decade in energy infrastructure investment, including working with Stem’s \~30GW portfolio of power plants. Based on my experience, I have realized that the fastest way to get power is by leveraging sites that already have a surplus.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=125779&key=user_uploads/600101/ef5466c5-b46e-4d56-9a5e-d3347efddc19)

**We build data centers 10x faster** 

Building a new data center the traditional way takes 2-10 years to start from scratch. Instead, our pilot:

* Had power online in 29 days, compared to a 700+ day standard (24x faster)
* Set up the site in 34 days
* Installed the hardware on site in 37 days (10x faster)
* Produced our first tokens in 39 days

Our projects are easier to finance and carry significantly less political risk because of their size and geographic diversification. Each data center has nearly uncorrelated power risk because outages almost always impact a 20 mile diameter or less, increasing minimum compute availability for inference.

**Our solution to the power problem**

The wait time for new power is 2-10 years. The US grid only adds about 55GW of new capacity each year, and Texas alone already has a 474GW large load queue. For inference (as much as 90% of AI compute demand), there is no reason to wait in line for permission to build a large site.

Instead, we’re focused on developing the 26,000 existing sites with on average 2.7MW of surplus power remaining (70GW). We’re actively developing 3 sites (\~20MW total) to serve approximately unbounded customer demand.

Are you going to be a part of our next build? You can start your reservation at <https://www.rewbi.com/compute>

launches.title: Rewbi - Using AI to optimize grid-connected battery storage
launches.tagline: Rewbi more than doubles grid-connected battery storage revenue.
launches.body:
**We’re Rewbi!**

**Rewbi uses AI to optimize grid-connected battery storage.** We generate revenue by charging batteries when electricity is cheap and discharging when electricity is expensive.

We rent battery storage for a fixed fee per month, and we earn **more than double** that fee in monthly revenue by dispatching the battery optimally.

Today, power companies use human traders to manually track grid conditions and update the battery’s dispatch schedule. However, batteries can adjust their power output **100x faster** than traditional power generation (e.g., hydro, coal, nuclear, gas), with the ability to go from full-speed charging to full-speed discharging in under a minute. **Electricity prices change every 5 minutes, often by 300% or more.** Our AI better tracks 100s of live inputs, and it makes decisions faster than a human operator (with lower overhead), **more than doubling revenue**.

Since starting YC, we’ve joined ERCOT (the Texas grid operator) as a registered power company.

**Our Team**

[Thomas](https://linkedin.com/in/thomas-marge) has built battery dispatch (and wind farm optimization) solutions for the past 8 years, including as founder of inBalance (YCW21, acquired by Stem, Inc. in January of 2023). [Derek](https://linkedin.com/in/derekmod) wrote his first commodity trading and risk management algorithm for a fund when he was 18, and he was the first technical hire at Adept - his models were used to raise over $400m. We’ve known each other for a decade - we met working together on grad level math courses as freshmen at Hopkins.

**Asks**

We would love to speak with battery storage developers - message us at <https://www.rewbi.com/contact> or email us at [founders@rewbi.com](mailto:founders@rewbi.com)!
